# /crav1-exploratory-test

[All skills](../skills.md) · Walkthrough: [From a built slice, exploratory test](../../from-exploratory-test.md) · Playbook: [`SKILL.md`](../../../.cursor/skills/crav1/crav1-exploratory-test/SKILL.md)

## Purpose

After a build of a slice already exists, use the slice in two passes and write down bugs.

## Runs when

A build of a slice already exists. Called by the user.

## Reads

In short: A built slice, the spec, and the plan.

Reads a built slice, `spec.md`, and `plan.md`.

## Writes

In short: Bugs in `docs/specs/<slug>/explore.md`.

Writes bugs in `docs/specs/<slug>/explore.md`.

## Does not

Leaves `spec.md`, `plan.md`, `tasks.md`, `verify.md`, application code, and the checks the plan already named alone.

Limits and exceptions: no build of the slice stops with nothing written. The second pass stops at `matched the first pass`, or sooner at `the user said stop`. It does not start Specify, Plan, or Build. It is not a starter option.

## You run next / Runs by itself

- You run next: [`/crav1-finalize-commit`](crav1-finalize-commit.md)
- Runs by itself: Calls [`/crav1-fix-bug`](crav1-fix-bug.md) only when the user says so in that turn.

## Lane and group

Lane: Cross-cutting. Group: Testing helpers. Starter option: no. Routing: [guild routing](../../guild-routing.md).

## Stage and since

Stage: stable. Since: 1.16.0 ([changelog](../../../CHANGELOG.md)).

## First prompt

```text
/crav1-exploratory-test

Use the slice once, then again with randomness. Write down bugs. Do not start Specify, Plan, or Build.
```
